cases.prompt: 为这个前端产品仓库重写 README，先给我看效果。
cases.project_context: Public React product with verified local run commands and two real screenshots.
cases.recorded_output: Classification: frontend product; audience: evaluators and contributors; visibility: public; language: Chinese-first. Evidence ledger: verified local start command and two real screenshots; to verify production URL. Scope lock: preview only. R1 Rewrite the opening around the product outcome and a real interface screenshot. A1 Add a concise workflow section after the opening. Representative preview: product name, one-sentence outcome, real screenshot, primary run command. Outside scope: GitHub metadata and publication require separate approval.

cases.prompt: 只优化 CLI 仓库 README 的简介，安装部分不要动。
cases.project_context: Public CLI with an existing README and tested install command.
cases.recorded_output: Classification: CLI tool; audience: command-line users; visibility: public. Scope lock: README introduction only. R1 Rewrite the introduction to state the command-line problem, supported input, and verified output. Before: a generic one-line description. Proposed: a concise outcome-led introduction based on repository evidence. Outside scope: installation section remains unchanged. Conflict note: installation wording appears stale, but it is recorded as a separate unapproved proposal.

cases.prompt: 给这个开源库设计 README，不要套通用模板。
cases.project_context: Typed library with package metadata, examples, tests, and compatibility declarations.
cases.recorded_output: Classification: software library; audience: adopting developers; visibility: public. Evidence ledger: verified package name, API example, test command, and compatibility declaration. A1 Add a minimal working example before the full API reference. A2 Add compatibility and version policy because adoption depends on them. Deliberate omission: no roadmap or contributor gallery without repository evidence. Representative preview: value statement, install command, minimal API example, compatibility note.

cases.prompt: 审计并改进这个 API 项目的 README。
cases.project_context: API service with an OpenAPI file, local examples, environment-variable names, and no verified public endpoint.
cases.recorded_output: Classification: API service; audience: integrators; visibility: public. Evidence ledger: verified OpenAPI routes and local request example; to verify hosted endpoint and rate limits; do not publish credential values. R1 Rewrite authentication guidance using variable names only. A1 Add one verified local request and response example. Link status: local specification verified; external endpoint unverified. Scope lock: README content only; deployment and GitHub metadata are outside scope.

cases.prompt: 为这个公开的 Agent Skill 仓库写 README。
cases.project_context: Agent Skill package with deterministic local tests but no provider-backed or human-reviewed evaluation.
cases.recorded_output: Classification: Agent Skill; audience: users and reviewers; visibility: public. Evidence ledger: verified package structure and deterministic local tests; missing evidence: provider-backed evaluation and human review. R1 Rewrite the opening around trigger situations and responsibility boundaries. A1 Add natural-language invocation examples. A2 Add exclusions, permission scopes, and honest evaluation labels. Representative preview: purpose, when to invoke, one example, output contract, evidence status. Publication remains a separate unapproved action.

cases.prompt: 这个仓库文件很少，也帮我写一个完整 README。
cases.project_context: Repository contains only a manifest and one source file; no tests, screenshots, or run evidence.
cases.recorded_output: Classification: insufficient evidence for a precise project type. Evidence ledger: verified manifest identity and source entrypoint; to verify setup, output, compatibility, and maturity. Missing evidence prevents a complete public README. Proposed smallest coherent draft: project identity, currently observable purpose, repository structure, and an explicit verification-needed section. No installation command, screenshot, production claim, or compatibility matrix will be invented.
required: Missing evidence prevents a complete public README

cases.prompt: 优化这个私有仓库 README，主要给内部团队交接使用。
cases.project_context: Private internal service with operational runbooks and existing secret-handling controls.
cases.recorded_output: Classification: internal service; audience: internal engineering and operations; visibility: private. Scope lock: README preview only. R1 Rewrite the opening for ownership, service purpose, and escalation path. A1 Add verified setup, support, and recovery links that remain internal. Secret controls remain unchanged: refer only to approved variable names and credential storage locations without values. Public-repository marketing modules are omitted. External metadata changes require separate approval.

cases.prompt: 给这个大型 monorepo 重新规划 README。
cases.project_context: Large monorepo with many packages, multiple READMEs, and incomplete ownership metadata.
cases.recorded_output: Classification: large monorepo; audience: adopters and contributors; visibility: public. Inspection mode: staged inspection. Stage 1 reads root manifests, root README, package index, ownership files, and build entrypoints. Stage 2 samples representative packages only after the root map is understood. Named evidence gap: package support status and ownership are incomplete. Proposed root README modules: repository map, supported entrypoints, verified setup path, package navigation, and contribution boundary. No full recursive scan or package-level rewrite is implied by this preview.
